items.requirement: Authorized GET /reservations/{holdId} success response includes existing hold detail fields (holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt) plus current availableStock for the hold's SKU. Missing or not-visible holds fail with PreconditionError; no stock or hold mutation on any path.
items.rationale: Callers need current available stock alongside hold details without a separate stock query; failure and non-mutation semantics must stay machine-checkable.
items.threshold: Authorized success always returns holdId, sku, quantity, expiresAt, and availableStock for the hold's SKU; missing/not-visible always fails as PreconditionError with zero stock/hold mutation.
items.measurement: OCL-derived Vitest contract tests plus OpenAPI success-schema and PreconditionError channel exercises for additive lookup response and non-mutation.

items.requirement: Only an authorized opaque principal may look up a soft-hold. Unauthorized callers fail with UnauthorizedError; stock and holds are unchanged.
items.rationale: Extends the settled opaque-principal authZ pattern on the existing GET lookup; not a new IAM product.
items.threshold: Unauthorized lookup always fails with UnauthorizedError and never mutates stock or holds; authorized opaque principal can look up when the hold is visible.
items.measurement: Contract tests and OpenAPI UnauthorizedError channel; OCL preconditions on lookup.

items.requirement: N/A — no latency or throughput targets for this evaluation sample.
items.rationale: Additive response-field change on the same sample workload; no SLI asked.

items.measurement: Presence of OpenAPI + OCL + passing Vitest under tests/contracts/** for the additive lookup response field and error paths.
